note: Surface playbooks are the tester-facing working layer: every applicable check for a page type, with named variants and copyable payloads. They reference methodology items; they do not replace them.

playbooks.title: Static / published page
playbooks.summary: No login, no first-party API. TLS, headers, host, paths, disclosure, and client framing.

playbooks.title: Login / identity page
playbooks.summary: Credential transport, enumeration, lockout, Host-poisoned reset links, session fixation, and login injection.

playbooks.title: Registration / signup
playbooks.summary: Enumeration, mass-assigned roles, verify-skip, Host-poisoned activation mail, and signup CSRF.

playbooks.title: Password reset / recovery
playbooks.summary: Host-poisoned reset mail, token reuse, cross-account bind, MFA wipe, and reset flooding.

playbooks.title: Account / profile page
playbooks.summary: IDOR, mass assignment, stored XSS, password/email change, CSRF, and clickjacking.

playbooks.title: Session / cookies
playbooks.summary: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, fixation, logout, and session identifiers in URLs.

playbooks.title: File upload
playbooks.summary: Extension vs magic, executable content, SVG, filename traversal, download IDOR, ZIP Slip, XXE.

playbooks.title: Search / listing
playbooks.summary: Reflected and stored XSS, SQL / NoSQL / SSTI in q=, authorization on results, scrape limits.

playbooks.title: Checkout / payments
playbooks.summary: Price and quantity tamper, currency, coupons, payment binding, checkout races, CSRF.

playbooks.title: Admin / privileged UI
playbooks.summary: Unauthenticated and member access to admin routes, verb swaps, impersonation, CSRF, clickjacking.

playbooks.title: API endpoint
playbooks.summary: Auth, object/function authorization, verb/content-type swaps, mass assignment, and SSRF-shaped URL fields.

playbooks.title: GraphQL endpoint
playbooks.summary: Introspection, node(id:) BOLA, field/mutation authorization, batching, CSRF, and depth/cost.

playbooks.title: WebSocket / realtime
playbooks.summary: WSS, Origin allowlist, socket auth, per-message authorization, and subscription IDOR.

playbooks.title: OAuth / SSO / SAML
playbooks.summary: redirect_uri, state, PKCE, code reuse, token leakage, SAML signatures, RelayState.

playbooks.title: JWT / bearer token
playbooks.summary: alg=none, key confusion, kid/jku tricks, role claims, expiry, and tokens in URLs.

playbooks.title: SPA / client-side
playbooks.summary: DOM XSS, postMessage, browser storage, client-only authorization, secrets in the bundle, CORS.
